description: This PHP source file defines a class named UpgradeRemoval used to support the removal of files and directories during a software upgrade process in the SuiteCRM project. It provides methods to determine which files should be removed, handle the removal process, and backup files before deletion. The class is intended to be extended for custom removal logic during upgrades.

classes.name: UpgradeRemoval
classes.description: A class to support removing files and directories during an upgrade process, including backup functionality.

methods.name: getFilesToRemove
methods.description: Returns an array of files/directories to remove, intended to be overridden for custom logic.

methods.name: processFilesToRemove
methods.description: Handles the removal of specified files/directories and backs them up beforehand.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Backs up a file or directory to the 'custom/backup' directory, creating necessary directories.
